baseline_models.focus_anchor: The frame إِن كَانَ مِنْ joins كَانَ (word 3) to أَصْحَابِ (5) and ٱلْيَمِينِ (6).
baseline_models.mechanism: Occurrence in a realized state is narrowed by مِنْ into membership; companionship makes that membership sustained, while the right hand or side supplies its orientation.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time supply the realized-state predicate.
Companionship and sustained attachment turn the plural into a durable cohort.
The right hand and right side provide the cohort's directional designation.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that someone belongs to the people of the right.
changed_reading.after: A conditional recognition that a realized person-state consists in durable attachment to the right-side cohort.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ combines the preservation branch of ص ح ب with the blessing branch of ي م ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship can itself preserve, and rightness can carry blessing; the title can therefore name a safeguarding relation rather than only a faction.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through accompaniment makes company an active protection.
Blessing and good fortune specify what the protective company bears.
Realized presence makes this protective relation the subject's condition.

changed_reading.before: The right is merely the favorable side occupied by a named group.
changed_reading.after: The subject's condition is to be kept within company that bears blessing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots in أَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ permit following or compliance, oath, and rightful power to meet in one title.
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship can shade into compliant following, while yamin can be oath and the side of power or right; together they suggest pledged alignment to a rightful authority.

activation_trace.role: Following after resistance supplies an allegiance-like relation.
The oath branch supplies the pledge by which alignment may be bound.
Power and right supply the authority or claim to which the cohort aligns.

changed_reading.before: Companions of the right is only a spatial or auspicious class name.
changed_reading.after: It may also describe a cohort bound in following to an oath-backed right or authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The breath reaches an irreversible limit, return is challenged and fails, and the same conditional ك و ن frame sorts three outcomes; focus membership becomes a disclosed terminal placement.

activation_trace.role: Sustained attachment anchors the disclosed placement in the focus cohort.
The right side names the placement disclosed at the threshold.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the terminal boundary before classification.
Return to the former state supplies the reversal whose impossibility makes the boundary decisive.
Realized occurrence opens the first parallel case and establishes the sorting syntax.
The same realized-state predicate opens the third case and brackets the focus as the middle placement.

structural_cues: 56:83-87 moves from reaching the throat through helpless observation to the challenge to return it.
56:88, 56:90, and 56:92 repeat the أَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنْ case frame, each followed by its own outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an endpoint, failed reversal, and repeated case frames; I infer that the sequence discloses classification at the death threshold. A live alternative is a logical afterlife taxonomy with no claim that classification temporally occurs at that instant.

changed_reading.before: The verse states an already familiar group affiliation.
changed_reading.after: At the irreversible threshold, the verse discloses the subject's realized placement in the middle of three outcome classes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate result repeats the cohort name while announcing salām; preservation by companionship and blessing by yamin become operational as safety-bearing welcome.

activation_trace.role: Preserving accompaniment supplies the active social quality of the focus cohort.
Blessing supplies the favorable force carried by that accompaniment.
Freedom from harm turns the following salām into the cohort's concrete outcome.
The repeated preservation branch links the announced safety directly back to companionship.
The repeated blessing branch identifies the safety-bearing company as the same focus cohort.

structural_cues: 56:91 immediately follows with result فَـ, addresses لَكَ, and repeats مِنْ أَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ nearly verbatim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate result syntax, safety, repeated companionship, and blessing; I infer that membership is experienced as welcome and assurance. Alternatively, مِنْ may classify the addressee rather than name the greeting's sender, but either construal makes salām the class's operative sign.

changed_reading.before: The title merely locates the subject in a favorable group.
changed_reading.after: Entry into that group inaugurates a social relation that bears and announces safety to the subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accounting and recompense test the claim, fulfilled truth confirms it, and fixed right plus certainty close the sequence; yamin's right and power branch becomes an adjudicated entitlement held by its companions.

activation_trace.role: Companionship, including being holder of or standing over a thing, supplies the possessor relation.
Right, power, and the strongest claim supply the entitlement under adjudication.
Accounting and recompense establish the adjudicative setting.
Fulfillment in action makes asserted truth answerable to proof.
A fixed obligation or entitlement supplies the legal closure of the right branch.
Settled knowledge removes uncertainty from the final determination.

structural_cues: 56:86-87 couples the claim of being unaccountable with a demand for truthful proof.
56:95 closes all three outcomes with حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, fulfilled truth, fixed entitlement, and certainty; I infer a legal arrow that turns yamin's power or right into an established claim. The live alternative is that these cues certify the whole discourse while yamin remains simply spatial or auspicious.

changed_reading.before: The companions occupy a symbolically favorable side.
changed_reading.after: They can also be heard as holders of a right made fixed and effective by settled accounting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening qasam carries both oath and allotted-share branches; those branches activate yamin as oath and companionship as the people attached to an oath-backed portion.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association supplies the people attached to the allotment.
The oath branch makes yamin resonate with the opening qasam.
An oath distributed among its people fuses pledge, allotment, and cohort in one branch image.
Separation of a share supplies the portion to which the companions may be attached.

structural_cues: 56:75-76 begins the packet with repeated verbal and nominal qasam before the later singular ٱلْيَمِينِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated qasam, a branch joining oath to distribution among people, and focus yamin as oath; I infer a long-distance resonance in which the cohort is attached to an oath-backed share. The stronger alternative is that qasam certifies the revelation only and yamin here remains side or blessing.

changed_reading.before: The cohort's name refers only to right-side location or good fortune.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it may also name the people attached to a pledged and allotted share.

context_deltas.mechanism: The three cases are rendered as distinct reception regimes: privileged nearness and agreeable lodging, safety for the right-side cohort, and inverted guest provision for deniers.

activation_trace.role: Companionship makes the focus placement a social affiliation within the reception order.
Blessing marks the quality of the focus cohort's reception.
Privileged nearness supplies the first case's access relation.
An agreeable place and pleasant stay render the first reception spatially.
Safety is the distinctive provision announced for the focus case.
Guest provision supplies the third case's deliberately inverted hospitality.

structural_cues: Each repeated conditional case in 56:88-94 is followed immediately by a compact nominal outcome.
The focus outcome stands between a pleasant abode and a hostile nuzul.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies privileged access, agreeable lodging, safety, and guest provision; I infer that neighboring outcomes form a reception architecture. A live alternative is that they are independent reward and punishment formulas without a shared hospitality mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus identifies membership in an abstract ranked class.
changed_reading.after: It identifies arrival into the middle reception regime, where social affiliation is concretely answered with safety.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because yamin's mortuary branch is distant from the usual faction label. It remains anchored in focus ي م ن and is activated by reaching the bodily endpoint and by death as release in the adjacent positive outcome. Downstream prose should present it only as a death-scene resonance, not as a lexical disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْيَمِينِ at word 6 has a branch in which death is associated with laying the dead on the right side.

activation_trace.role: The mortuary right-side image supplies a bodily orientation within the death scene.
Companionship keeps the resonance attached to the cohort title rather than an isolated posture.
Reaching the endpoint places the focus sequence at the bodily threshold of death.
Death expressed through relief keeps death itself live in the neighboring positive outcome.

changed_reading.before: Right functions only as a symbolic side of fortune or rank.
changed_reading.after: Within the deathbed sequence, right faintly also evokes mortuary orientation, making the cohort title and the scene of dying overlap.

strongest_changes: The repeated conditional frames around 56:90 turn static group membership into terminal classification at an irreversible threshold.
The immediate salām in 56:91 makes companionship operational as safety-bearing welcome.
Accounting, fulfilled truth, fixed right, and certainty activate yamin as adjudicated entitlement.
summary.what_was_special: One compact title sustained spatial, social, legal, oath-bearing, and mortuary mechanisms without requiring them to collapse into one interpretation; the deathbed triad gave those branches functional sequence.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether salām is sent by the companions or declares safety for one classified among them.
Whether the qasam-to-yamin oath echo is intended or only a branch-level resonance.
Whether the mortuary yamin activation is more than contextual wordplay.
